sync_akeneo.description: Import Akeneo product catalogs, family-driven attributes, and products into ILA3 Commerce with resilient batch sync.
sync_akeneo.mapping.createMissingChannel: Create missing ILA3 Commerce sales channels from Akeneo scopes by default
sync_akeneo.mapping.customFields.help: One mapping per line: attribute_code,target(product|variant),field_key[,kind][,skip]. After valid Akeneo credentials are saved, ILA3 Commerce discovers mappings automatically: variant axes stay as product options, and other relevant Akeneo attributes are auto-mapped as custom fields unless you override them here. Use the editor skip checkbox when an Akeneo attribute should be ignored entirely. Product imports create or update missing ILA3 Commerce custom field definitions automatically and store the Akeneo metadata, validation rules, and groups on those fields.
sync_akeneo.mapping.fieldsets.help: Discovered Akeneo families become ILA3 Commerce fieldsets automatically. Adjust the fieldset code, label, or description here, and add manual family-variant rows when a specific Akeneo family variant should use a different variant fieldset.
sync_akeneo.mapping.media.help: One mapping per line: attribute_code,target(product|variant),kind(image|file). Image mappings are re-hosted into ILA3 Commerce attachments and can become default media; file mappings are imported as attachments.
sync_akeneo.mapping.productLocale.help: Only this Akeneo locale is imported into the base ILA3 Commerce fields for now. Other locales are ignored until translation import is added.
sync_akeneo.setup.credentials.step1: In Akeneo, open Settings -> Connections and create a new API connection or connected app for ILA3 Commerce.
sync_akeneo.setup.credentials.step2: Copy the Akeneo base URL, client id, and client secret into the Integration credentials tab in ILA3 Commerce.
sync_akeneo.setup.docs.note1: Akeneo authentication uses client id, client secret, username, and password. ILA3 Commerce exchanges those for access/refresh tokens automatically.
sync_akeneo.setup.docs.note3: Simple Akeneo products still create a default ILA3 Commerce variant. Variant Akeneo products flatten the full Akeneo product-model tree into one configurable product plus child variants.
sync_akeneo.setup.docs.note4: If you want channel offers and prices, create matching Sales Channels and Catalog Price Kinds in ILA3 Commerce first, then reference their codes in the mapping blocks below.
